title: Due Date of a Loss-of-Use Payment After a Supplemental or Final Report — Excess Flood Claims
content:
For late-payment interest on an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** loss-of-use payment, the kind of the latest adjuster report can set the due date.

## Rule

Where the latest adjuster report of the claim is a SUPPLEMENTAL report, the loss-of-use payment is due the tier's claim-payment days after that report; where the latest report is a FINAL report and a proof of loss for loss of use is on file, the payment is due the tier's claim-payment days after the later of the latest proof of loss for loss of use and the report. Interest days are the days after the due date, and there are none until it has passed. For any other latest report, this provision sets no due date.

The claim-payment period is 30 calendar days on every tier. The claim is the claim of the policy that carries the latest adjuster report, and every claim figure is read from that claim's own entries. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

| Latest adjuster report | Proof of loss for loss of use on file | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| SUPPLEMENTAL | either | 30 days after that report |
| FINAL | yes | 30 days after the later of the latest such proof of loss and the report |
| FINAL | no | not set by this provision |
| any other kind | either | not set by this provision |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

A SUPPLEMENTAL report dated 50 days before the payment: due 20 days before it, 20 interest days. A FINAL report dated 70 days before the payment with a proof of loss for loss of use received 45 days before: due 15 days before, 15 interest days. A SUPPLEMENTAL report dated 25 days before the payment: the due date has not passed, no interest days.
